fields.description: Received stock awaiting inspection is routed here when the QC gate is soft (disabled above).
fields.label: Default Quarantine Warehouse

fields.description: Damaged or rejected stock is routed here.
fields.label: Default Rejected Warehouse

fields.description: If a bin has less space than the incoming qty, split the putaway task across multiple bins.
fields.label: Allow Partial Bin Fill

fields.description: Bins of these types are never suggested for putaway or picking.
fields.label: Exclude Bin Types from Suggestion

fields.description: Used when a bin has no max_capacity set. 0 means unlimited.
fields.label: Default Bin Capacity

fields.description: When enabled, items requiring inspection are blocked at receipt until a Quality Inspection is passed. Requires ERPNext QC module setup.
fields.label: Enable QC Hold Gate (Hard)

fields.description: If checked, cancelling a Purchase Receipt will automatically cancel its open WMS tasks. If unchecked, cancellation is blocked until the tasks are cancelled.
fields.label: Allow PR Cancellation with Open Tasks

fields.description: When enabled, the receiving screen requires a reason whenever received qty is less than pending qty on a PO line. The reason is written back to the PO Item.
fields.label: Capture Short Receipt Reason

fields.description: When enabled, the pick confirmation screen requires scanning the item barcode before confirming.
fields.label: Require Item Scan on Pick

fields.description: Manual: supervisor releases DNs from the mobile app. Auto: pick tasks are created automatically when a Draft DN is created.
When enabled, a Delivery Note cannot be submitted unless every item is packed into at least one Sealed WMS Package. When disabled, any Open packages are auto-sealed on submit.
